our_interpretation: The checkable commitment is the prevalence of smooth, slow-moving shots among unique Sora samples publicly available by February 17, 2024.
Vast majority means a clearly overwhelming share, not merely more than half. No precise percentage is supplied or imposed.
Each sample should be classified by its predominant visible motion, distinguishing camera movement from subject movement.
The local-patches explanation is a tentative inference. Motion prevalence alone cannot establish the model's internal understanding.
Samples so far includes public launch material and publicly shared demonstrations, rather than only examples selected by the evaluator.
criteria.support_condition: A dated, sufficiently complete inventory and reproducible motion review show that a clearly overwhelming share of the eligible samples predominantly use smooth pans and slow motion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The same review shows that such samples are clearly not an overwhelming share. A few fast or multi-shot examples alone do not contradict a majority claim.
